limitations: Inspected all four available neutral images for each of twelve views in reverse packet order, alongside task, fixture, geometry and recorded traces. These are captures and scripted observations, not a user study or proof of ease.
Neutral CSS can remove color-only state cues and change font reflow. In particular, the blank view-01 row and neutral option indicators require authored-stage confirmation.

The 320px information is document-width metadata only; it is not full narrow-screen interaction or visual testing. Transfer traces retain failure summaries but do not separately exercise editing after failure. Commerce screenshots show cart feedback, not a complete cart editing or removal flow.
